title: Run a 1:1 That Leaves an Agenda and a Follow-up
objective: Produce a timed 1:1 agenda and a written follow-up for a named person that includes one growth topic, one hard topic, and actions the lead also owns.
whyThisMatters: A 1:1 that only happened is not mentorship a mentor can inspect. The agenda, the notes that separate fact from interpretation, and the follow-up with owners and dates are the work.
evidence: A timed agenda for a 30- or 45-minute 1:1 whose topic times sum to the stated length, including one growth topic and one hard topic
Meeting notes that mark at least one sentence as an observed fact and at least one sentence as an interpretation
A follow-up note listing at least two actions, each with an owner and a date, of which at least one action is the lead's
acceptanceCriteria: The agenda lists timed topics whose minutes sum to the stated 30- or 45-minute length and includes both a growth topic and a hard topic.
The notes explicitly label at least one sentence as fact and at least one sentence as interpretation.
The follow-up lists at least two actions with owner and date, and at least one action is assigned to the lead.
